title: Invertibility of the surviving diagonal map
statement: Let C be an abelian category and K an integer commuting double cochain complex with total [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let r be natural and assume K.X i is zero for i<0 or r<=i. Let A be an integer cochain complex, b:A→Tot(K), and f_p:single(A.X p,0)→K.flip.X p for every integer p. Let F be a decreasing filtration of Cone(b) [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], whose degree-n step p is the join of the source image when p<=n+1 and the target diagonal images indexed by 0<=i<r and p<=n-i. The canonical map [def-sc-finite-strip-cone-graded-map] from Cone(f_p)^(n-p) to gr_F^p Cone(b)^n is invertible for all integer p,n. No augmentation or differential identification hypothesis is needed.

theorem finiteStripGradedMap_isIso
    (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    [K.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ)] (r : ℕ)
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ (r : ℤ) ≤ i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (A : CochainComplex C ℤ) (b : A ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (f : ∀ p : ℤ,
      (HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj (A.X p) ⟶ K.flip.X p)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone b))
    (hsteps : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
      (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl b).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
      (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (r : ℤ)).sup (fun i ↦
        if p ≤ n - i then imageSubobject
          (K.ιTotalOrZero (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i (n - i) n ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr b).f n) else ⊥))
    (p n : ℤ) : IsIso (finiteStripGradedMap K r hsupport A b f F hsteps p n)
